scope: Initial receive-analysis knowledge, not an exhaustive frequency allocation database

entries.name: IEEE 802.11 2.4 GHz family
entries.verification: Pinned gr-ieee802-11 legacy20MHz OFDM preamble, PHY decoding and CRC32 frame integrity; other PHYs unsupported
entries.notes: Broad prior envelope, not channel availability or regional allocation; a/g/p reference does not cover all Wi-Fi PHYs

entries.name: Bluetooth LE
entries.verification: LE1M advertising access address, dewhitening, valid header, CRC24
entries.notes: Listed centers are primary advertising channels, not all 40 LE channels

entries.name: Bluetooth BR/EDR
entries.verification: analyze_bluetooth_classic searches exact libbtbb BR/EDR syncwords in focused1MHz channels at4MS/s. Synchronization candidates are not HEC/payload-CRC-validated frames. Full protocol confirmation still requires independent header/payload integrity evidence.

entries.name: IEEE 802.15.4 2.4 GHz family (Zigbee/Thread candidates)
entries.verification: O-QPSK DSSS250kb/s synchronization, MAC FCF checks and CRC16/KERMIT; upper-layer identity remains unknown
entries.notes: Channels11..26 at2405+5*(channel-11)MHz; no Zigbee/Thread inference from PHY alone; controlled RF-positive qualification pending

entries.name: Other/custom radios or noncommunication interference
entries.verification: Generic features, repetition and temporal behavior; unknown is an allowed result
entries.notes: Unverified generic hypothesis; not a specific protocol or allocation claim

fallback: Always analyze all detected events, including those outside these priors.
